SummaryGhost of Yōtei: Echoes of Sekigahara is a new narrative expansion. Split between the present day and flashbacks to Atsu’s time on the mainland, you’ll meet Nagato, a figure from Atsu’s past who has arrived in Ezo. In the present, you’ll explore a previously unseen valley once inhabited by The Snake and his gang of loyal followers, the Vipers. In ...

Oct 23, 2026
90
TheSixthAxis
For a tenner to upgrade to the Complete Edition, Echoes of Sekighara is an absolute steal and one that perfectly rounds out the Ghost of Yotei package. The new region and questlines seamlessly slot into the base game while enhancing it with some fun yet minor gameplay additions. On top of that, Most Wanted offers a dynamic new way to experience combat.
PlayStation 5 FULL REVIEW
Oct 9, 2026
90
Retcon
Echoes of Sekigahara will take you around seven to eight hours to complete, with a fair bit of optional content to dive into alongside the main story offerings. I think it’s an excellent extension of the already engaging revenge story present in Ghost of Yotei, and a great reason for fans to return to Ezo once more.

GamersRD
Ghost of Yōtei: Echoes of Sekigahara is a DLC that expands Atsu's journey without altering the base game's core formula. Its storyline, new region, side activities, and the Most Wanted mode deliver compelling content for players eager to return to this world. While it doesn't reinvent the original experience, it stands as a worthwhile expansion for those craving more.
PlayStation 5 FULL REVIEW
Oct 5, 2026
80
GamingBolt
The free new rogue-lite mode may turn some heads, but Echoes of Sekigahara is the real star, delivering a strong narrative and a small but packed new region. It doesn't significantly build on or alter Yōtei's core gameplay, but it remains enjoyable.
PlayStation 5 FULL REVIEW
Oct 1, 2026
80
ComicBook
Most Wanted, while ultimately a welcome addition, has its share of problems, but it is certainly the weaker part of the Ghost of Yotei‘s new DLC. Echoes of Sekigahara is significantly more elegant, tying the themes of redemption and guilt seen in its story into the very soil of its world. Ghost of Yotei followed in Ghost of Tsushima‘s footsteps in a lot of ways, and now the two share yet another aspect: a well-crafted expansion that has some of the best moments of the entire game.
PlayStation 5 FULL REVIEW
